scope: Disposable synthetic SQLite queue and two barrier-started producer calls.
fixture_population: One normal enqueue plus 9,998 direct synthetic inserts, then two barrier-started producers; not throughput or sustained load.
limitations: One finite two-producer race; not all interleavings, multi-host/distributed behavior, throughput, soak, disk exhaustion or physical acceptance. Edge commit is not central commit.
sanitization: Aggregate outcomes/counts/assertions only; no credentials, identities, event keys, payloads, database files or local paths exported.
